  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const form = document.getElementById('klaviyo_back_in_stock_form')

    form.addEventListener('submit', async (event) => {
      event.preventDefault()

      const email = document.getElementById('bis_email').value
      const variantId = document.getElementById('bis_variant_id').value
      const newsletterOptIn = document.getElementById('newsletter_opt_in').checked
      const publicKey = ''

      let bisFetchSuccess = false
      let newsletterFetchSuccess = false

      const bisUrl = `https://a.klaviyo.com/client/back-in-stock-subscriptions/?company_id=${publicKey}`

      const bisPayload = {
        data: {
          type: 'back-in-stock-subscription',
          attributes: {
            profile: {
              data: {
                type: 'profile',
                attributes: { email },
              },
            },
            channels: ['EMAIL'],
          },
          relationships: {
            variant: {
              data: {
                type: 'catalog-variant',
                id: `$shopify:::$default:::${variantId}`,
              },
            },
          },
        },
      }

      const bisFetchOptions = {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          revision: '2025-01-15',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(bisPayload),
      }

      const bisResponse = await fetch(bisUrl, bisFetchOptions)
      if (bisResponse.ok) {
        bisFetchSuccess = true
      } else {
        console.error('Back in stock subscription failed:', bisResponse)
      }

      if (newsletterOptIn) {
        const newsletterUrl = `https://a.klaviyo.com/client/subscriptions/?company_id=${publicKey}`

        const newsletterPayload = {
          data: {
            type: 'subscription',
            attributes: {
              profile: {
                data: {
                  type: 'profile',
                  attributes: { email },
                },
              },
            },
            relationships: {
              list: {
                data: {
                  type: 'list',
                  id: 'Rk7yBD',
                },
              },
            },
          },
        }

        const newsletterFetchOptions = {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            revision: '2025-01-15',
          },
          body: JSON.stringify(newsletterPayload),
        }

        const newsletterResponse = await fetch(newsletterUrl, newsletterFetchOptions)
        if (newsletterResponse.ok) {
          newsletterFetchSuccess = true
        } else {
          console.error('Newsletter subscription failed:', newsletterResponse)
        }
      }

      if (bisFetchSuccess && (newsletterOptIn ? newsletterFetchSuccess : true)) {
        form.innerHTML = `<p class="!text-[15px]">thank you, we will email you when the item is available for purchase again${
          newsletterOptIn ? ", and you've joined the newsletter" : ''
        }.</p>`
      } else if (bisFetchSuccess && !newsletterFetchSuccess) {
        form.innerHTML = `<p class="!text-[15px]">thank you, we will email you when the item is available for purchase again. However, the newsletter signup failed.</p>`
      } else if (!bisFetchSuccess && newsletterFetchSuccess) {
        form.innerHTML = `<p class="!text-[15px]">Newsletter subscribed, but the product alert failed.</p>`
      } else {
        form.innerHTML = `<p class="!text-[15px]">Something went wrong. Please try again later.</p>`
      }

      document.querySelector('.bis-continue-shopping-btn').classList.remove('!hidden')
    })
  })
